answer: In an EigenTrust-style trust graph, reputation is discounted by exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life, so identities need sustained, reciprocated honest service to retain weight. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagates only supported trust; freshly spawned sybil identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality. Even an orchard of coordinated new accounts cannot push each vertex over the consensus ledge without durable endorsements.
